subject: computer-science
title: Networks & Security: Foundations
welcome_lead: Computers chat in networks — let's see who is talking to whom.
meta_desc: KS3 networks: LAN, WAN, devices and basic security.
final_note: Knowing the network helps you keep yourself safe online.

concepts.def: Two or more devices connected to share data.
Local Area Network — a network in one place.
Wide Area Network — across cities or countries.
Device that joins networks and directs traffic.
Computer that provides services to others.
Device that asks a server for something.

walkthroughs.body_html: A LAN covers a building, like your school. A WAN connects places far apart. The internet is the biggest WAN of all.
A client (your laptop) asks. A server answers. Web pages, email and games all rely on this relationship.
A router reads the address on each packet and sends it the right way. Without routers, the internet would be silent.
